title: Rethymno
body:
Like the sea merging with the stars
is you and me, a few empty summers.
Your land is an island, the wave caresses it;
my journey is you, seeking your soil.

And Rethymno awakens to bring love,
in a passion that begs for just a little more summer...

I kissed your gaze with the lips of my eyes,
I tasted a sweet August dusk.
"A little blue, a lot of water," you told me your secret;
was your hand cool, or was it your smile?

And Rethymno awakens to bring love,
in a passion that begs for just a little more summer...

Tonight I'll come to your shore on a boat,
my map is a canvas, my compass your body.
What worth is life without a touch of madness;
how sweet life is, seen through a girl's eyes!

And Rethymno awakens to bring love,
in a passion that begs for just a little more summer...
